video_title: [Cover] The Bells of Notre Dame (Ending) - The Hunchback of Notre Dame
description:
Hunchback is one of my all time faves and this song is just epic. What a way to open a movie! I've never been able to sustain the last high note before without running out of breath at the end but I wanted to give it a go! I decided to do it a semi-tone higher because it was for some reason easier to sustain the note for me. 

The opera chorus you hear in the background is actually me and my amazing friend  @ElsieLovelock  we did quite a few years back when we did a full cover of the song. We stacked so many vocal track! Ah good times.

video_title: Dreamy Date Drive (from Owarimonogatari) Swedish Cover
description:
I'm really sorry for the massive gap between the last cover and this one. I was (surprisingly) working hard on an assignment for school that I was actually a bit passionate about (for once) so I didn't have a lot of time for recording. Even so, I had to wait until this day because Mondays are the only day that the owner of the recording equipment isn't home (that's when I steal it, quickly record, then return it). So unless something cool happens, don't expect any covers until next Monday at the earliest, possibly even later. 

Anyways, this is the second to last opening from Owarimonogatari, which means we're close to the end. After the Owarimonogatari openings it will get more complicated. There IS the Zoku Owarimonogatari opening "07734", but that one is very complex and barely has any proper vocals. If I get lots of requests for it I will think about it, but right now I won't promise it will happen. What will happen regardless is a cover of Wicked Prince from the Monogatari phone game "Monogatari Puc Puc", which will be lots of fun since it has vocals from all 10 heroines that have openings (excluding Kaiki for some reason though). After that I will consider doing a few more Monogatari endings, but definitely not all of them as they are a lot less connected to the show and are "real songs" rather than just (fantastic) character songs. Then I will have to think hard about how to move forward, because there are lots of possibilities. I could go back to making shitty covers of random anime songs in Japanese, but that feels very unfocused. I will most likely continue with Swedish stuff, but not necessarily songs. I want to fandub some of my favourite Monogatari scenes in Swedish, so that might be a thing. If you have any ideas, just comment. Now, just enjoy the cover and here are the lyrics:

video_title: Final Fantasy X - A Fleeting Dream Harmonica C Major // Cover By Mandy
description:
My Harmonica: 
Thomann Chromatic 40 
C Major

I wanted to make another harmonica cover but all the songs I really wanna cover are tuned in minor and my harmonica is in the major scale unfortunately but I decided to try out a favourite theme of mine from Final Fantasy X. 

I`m sorry if it sounds weird but this is the best I could do at this point. 
I`ve only really practiced with the harmonica for maybe 5-10 hours at maximum so my skills aren`t that great yet,  but I`m learning and it is so fun to figure stuff like how to play and etc. 
I`m selftaught but I will get better eventually and buy myself another harmonica in the minor scale. ^^

Turn on english subtitles in the video for translation! ^^ 

While on my way home from friends I came across an old song by Ted Gärdestad called För Kärlekens Skull (For Love`s Sake) and I just wanted to make a cover of it really badly. ^^
I think I`ve been feeling sort of sad from time to time, because I`m not were I wanna be in life right now even though I know it`s on it`s way but it`s hard to just sit there and wait for it. 
Makes me sad sometimes and this song sort of channels those inner feelings. 
Anyway, I hope you will enjoy it.

video_title: Death Stranding (James Blunt - Cold Cover By Mandy)
description:
I fallen in love with James Blunt`s recent song from last year called Cold
wich is sort of a sequel to his other hit song You`re Beautiful. 
According to the singer at least wich was very fun to hear.

I`ve only been playing a little bit so far in Hideo Kojimas new game Death Stranding but I thought the two different pieces fit well together plus I wanted to cover the song anyway so it`s a win-win for me this way! :)
This was by far one of the most difficult songs I covered in a long time simply because of how it`s sung but I feel satisfied with this version now! :D
Remember that I`m from Sweden so English is only my second language. 

I just used the launch trailer for the game and a karaoke version of the song and there you have it! 
This felt like such a fun mix of the two. 
I reccomend you listen with headphones for this song! ;D 
I Hope you enjoy my cover of the song! ^^
P.S.
I will finish this game! ;)

description:
THE FULL COVER IS ON MY PAGE 🎬

Mom: @voroninaolga 

This is what filming this cover looked like 😅
It was a lot of fun. Now we have a rule: it’s actually better to eat something before filming so you have energy and don’t mess up the lyrics. I usually film a lot of takes, so it’s definitely better not to be hungry 🥗🍜

Did you know it’s easier for me to play the asalato with my eyes closed? When I first started learning, we often had power outages here in Ukraine — sometimes for 3–4 days or even longer. I spent many evenings practicing in complete darkness (without internet or power).

Now it’s actually easier for me to play with my eyes closed, or not look at the asalato at all, relying only on touch and muscle memory. If I look at my hands, I can get thrown off — even though I already feel quite confident with the instrument.
So that’s just a little thing about me 🙂

video_title: Robbie Williams - No Regrets (Cover By Princecid)
description:
This song came out in 1998 and I used to listen to this album many many times! 
Good good times indeed. 

I recently started to listen to this song again and it makes sense now to me in alot of ways. 
Im a year older today, yay for finally turning 27! 

(7th of August, don`t know why it says 6th in the date of the video!?)

My skills in fandubbing and singing has improved HUGE during these past years on youtube and think it has to do with having so many friends who are so talented in different ways. 
That in turn forces me to become even better because if there is one thing I hate it is to look back on something and feel big regret over having made a thing that`s only half ass in quality. 

So I guess the red thread here is to never look back with regret over decisions you made in the past.
Face forward with head up high and just go for it! 
Don`t leave no stone unturned, go to new exciting places if that`s what you wanna do, try unique flavours of food and drinks, take time to cherish what you have while it still last because nothing lasts forever, remember that. 

Maybe Im wiser or just pretty delerious, I don`t know?  

Anyway, enjoy my cover of this wonderful little song. 
Thank you Robbie!

video_title: [Rhea Cover] Art of War
description:
After almost a month of work back and forth with the vocals, mix and video, it is finally done. 

This cover (despite some sour notes here and there) is the best cover I've done so far. I mean, I have others which I am proud of and like for various reasons, but this one is really close to my heart and I think I put in a bit more than just my heart into this work. I'd say "Happy 350 subscribers to myself" for this video, but uhm. I'm missing 5 haha. Oh well, let's just see this one as a celebration video in advance. I'll reach 350 subscribers one day (hopefully lol).

Art of War, by We the Kings, could be interpreted in many different ways. I chose to interpret it with the help of the anime NO.6 which holds one of the #1 spots of all-time favorites. (I tried to keep it simple...)

NO.6 is basically about an utopia after the world has been destroyed. Shion, a boy living in the privileged area of the utopia (NO.6), is thrown into a war against the city he's been born in and the one, Nezumi, who saved his life when his previous life turned against him. 
Nezumi is pretty much the typical lone-wolf who only paid back his debt to Shion and keeps his distance, but as they continue to live together, Shion is starting to get under his skin. This is where the part "but you know me too well" comes in.

Thank you Jinyeon (angelnaykka22) for telling me to use NO.6. Although, afterwards, I am not sure if I love you more or less for it. The feels. Ugh. Jk♥

video_title: Oliver and Company - Good Company Cover By Princecid
description:
Instrumental by King-Jo
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OUMdnBe7jxU

Inspired by my good friend  TheSnowDroplette I decided to do a cover of this heartwarming song. 

I always get tearful when I listen to Jenny sing this in the movie because the song has so much meaning if you`ve ever owned a most beloved pet. 

I used to have cats, a rabbit and even a dog at one point in my entire life. So even though its a simple song it really means alot to me.

video_title: MLP - Freebird Swedish Cover (Applejack Tribute)
description:
I strongly advise to listen with headphones for maximum enjoyment! 

So I`ve wanted to make another tribute with the mane 6 again and I finally decided on a song to cover and like regular tradition I do it in swedish because thats home for me. 

The song is Freebird by Lynyrd Skynyrd. 

I am sure most of you have heard this classic rock song at least once in your life I hope because its holds a special feeling in my soul. 
It seemed to fit Applejack because its a southern song and about never changing who you are as a person. At least thats my interpretation of it. 

I added english lyrics so you can follow along with my foreign words and I even changed some of the lyrics to fit Applejacks style. Cool huh!? ;D 

I sang this like normal first but when you start to have fun with the speed of the video you can change the pitch also and it sounded better like this so thats why my voice sounds a bit chipmunky but its all for the good cause of the video. 

Plus it makes it easier to edit when everything dosen`t move so slowly forward. 

I made this in total of 4 days. 
Singing the cover, edit the cover, translating and making the video like I did with stairway to heaven. 

I am kind of proud over this so it would be nice to hear your feedback sweeties! ;D 

Enjoy! :D

description:
🎵 Another Time, Another Place — The Amateur Crooner

Sometimes this world can leave us longing for something more.

We experience beautiful moments here, but they don't last forever. We have joys that come and go, and we face disappointments and heartaches that remind us that this world isn't our final home.

“Another Time, Another Place” looks beyond all of that toward the day when we will finally see Jesus face to face. ❤️

The song paints such a beautiful picture of Heaven—a place where tears are gone, fears are erased, and the things we've only hoped for become reality.

🎵 Even If — The Amateur Crooner

What happens when we pray for something with all our hearts—and the answer isn't what we hoped for?

🎵 There'll Be Peace in the Valley — The Amateur Crooner

There are times when this world can feel anything but peaceful.

We see suffering, conflict, heartache, and uncertainty all around us. And sometimes we find ourselves longing for a place where there will be no more sadness, no more sorrow, and no more trouble. ❤️

“There'll Be Peace in the Valley” is a beautiful gospel song that looks forward to that promised peace.

Written by Thomas A. Dorsey in 1939, the song has become a beloved gospel standard and has been recorded by many artists over the years. Elvis Presley recorded his version in 1957, bringing this beautiful song to an even wider audience.

I especially love the picture the song gives us of a world transformed—a place where even the animals live together peacefully and where the troubles of this present life are finally gone.

There'll be peace in the valley. What a beautiful promise to look forward to.

video_title: 'Til the Storm Passes By (With Lyrics) Gaither Vocal Band Cover
description:
🎵 ’Til the Storm Passes By — The Amateur Crooner

There are some songs that seem to understand exactly what we're feeling when life gets hard. “’Til the Storm Passes By” is one of those songs.

Written by Mosie Lister in 1958, this beloved Southern Gospel song is a heartfelt prayer for God's protection in the middle of life's storms. Lister wrote both the words and music, and the song was published in 1958.

I love that the song doesn't pretend the storms aren't real. The thunder is still crashing. The night can still feel dark. There may not seem to be anywhere to hide. Instead, the prayer is simply: Lord, hold me until the storm passes.

That makes this song especially meaningful because sometimes that's exactly what we need from God. We may not be asking Him to explain everything or even to make the storm disappear immediately. We just need to know that He is with us and that He will hold us safely through it.

The chorus gives us such a beautiful picture of God's care—being held securely in the hollow of His hand. What a comforting image when we're frightened, weary, or uncertain about what tomorrow may bring.

And the song doesn't end with the storm. It looks forward to the day when the long night is over, the storms are gone, and we will stand in God's presence on that bright, peaceful shore.

I think that's what makes this old gospel song so powerful. It acknowledges the reality of suffering while still looking beyond it. The storm is not forever.

If you're going through a storm right now, I hope this song feels like a little prayer you can borrow until you have words of your own. And if life is peaceful for you today, perhaps it will remind you to pray for someone whose storm is still raging. ❤️

🎵 Song: ’Til the Storm Passes By
✍️ Words & Music: Mosie Lister (1958)
🎤 Performed by: The Amateur Crooner

May God hold you safely in the hollow of His hand ’til the storm passes by. ❤️

description:
🎵 Come You Unfaithful — The Amateur Crooner

Christmas has a way of reminding us that Jesus didn't come because we had everything together. He came because we needed Him.

“Come You Unfaithful” is a newer Christmas song by Michael Boggs and Josh Nichols, released by Boggs in 2023. It uses the familiar melody of “O Come, All Ye Faithful,” but replaces the traditional words with a very different—and deeply personal—invitation.

Instead of calling only the faithful to come and worship, this song calls the unfaithful, the unworthy, the anxious, the weary, the broken, and even the prideful to come to Jesus.

And I think that's what makes this song so powerful.

How many of us have felt unworthy? How many have struggled with doubt, anxiety, unanswered questions, or simply the feeling that we haven't been faithful enough?

Yet the message of Christmas is that Christ came for us anyway.

Michael Boggs has shared that as a child, he wondered about the words “O Come, All Ye Faithful.” If only the faithful were invited to come to Jesus, he wondered what that meant for someone who didn't feel faithful. That thought eventually became the inspiration for this song.

And what a beautiful answer the song gives: Come anyway.

Come with your burdens.
Come with your questions.
Come with your failures.
Come with nothing to offer but yourself.

Because Christmas isn't a reward for people who have everything figured out. It's a celebration of the Savior who came for the broken, the weak, the sinner, and the lost.

I love that this song takes a familiar Christmas melody and turns it into such a personal invitation. Maybe that's something we all need to hear sometimes: Jesus didn't wait for us to become worthy before He came looking for us.

He came for us.

video_title: Why Me, Lord? A Powerful Kris Kristofferson Cover (With Lyrics!)
description:
🎵 Why Me, Lord? — The Amateur Crooner

Some songs feel less like a performance and more like a prayer—and “Why Me, Lord?” is certainly one of those songs.

Written by Kris Kristofferson in 1972, this deeply personal song is a humble reflection on grace, gratitude, regret, and the overwhelming realization that God’s love is something we could never earn.

The song came during a significant spiritual experience in Kristofferson’s life. After attending a church service, he found himself deeply moved and began wrestling with questions about his own life, his need for God, and the kindness and forgiveness he had received. He later described the experience as something he could hardly explain.

And perhaps that's what makes this song so powerful. The question “Why me?” isn't really about wondering why we deserve blessings. It's the humble realization that we don't deserve them—and yet God loves us anyway.

There are times when we can look back at our own lives and ask the same question: Lord, why have You been so good to me? Why have You continued to love me, forgive me, and reach for me even when I haven't always gotten things right?

The answer isn't that we earned His goodness. It's grace.

I hope this rendition of “Why Me, Lord?” gives you a quiet moment to reflect on the incredible love and mercy of God—and perhaps reminds you, as it reminds me, that none of us are beyond His reach.

🎼 Song Credits

✍️ Words & Music: Kris Kristofferson
📅 Written: 1972
🎤 Original Artist: Kris Kristofferson
🎤 Cover performed by: The Amateur Crooner

May we never take His grace for granted. ❤️

video_title: Peos vaggsång (från "Tillbaka till Vintergatan") Cover
description:
Här är en egen cover på en sång som spelades i avsnitt 18 av första säsongen av programmet "Tillbaka till Vintergatan" som gick när jag var liten. Älskade det programmet! I avsnittet sjunger Anders Linder, som spelar Peo, en vaggsång för den sjuke karaktären Glenn. Jag fann den sången ganska bra gjord och passande för avsnittet och flera år efter att jag såg det kunde jag fortfarande nynna lite grann på den vid ett eller annat tillfälle.

Idag, den 13 juni, är det dessutom på datumet 17 år sedan det första avsnittet sändes på SVT, så därför gör jag det lite till ett jubileum med att lägga ut en egen inspelning av Peos vaggsång.

Hoppas ni gillar min version av den!

video_title: [Swedish Cover] I Stand Alone - Quest for Camelot

I should do it more.

Sorry for the rushed intro, timing is not my forté. Hope you like it still!

video_title: [Cover] Dusk Till Dawn - ZAYN ft. Sia

Elsie's channel (if you haven't checked her out yet then what are you even doing): https://www.youtube.com/user/SweetPoffin

I really liked this song when I first heard it and wanted to sing it. Say what you want about 1D but Zayn is a pretty great singer. I liked the Bollywood influences so I got to use a little bit of my Desi backgournd haha. I love Sia as well so this duet was perfect. 

We do all voices and backings. Also did those little voice clips in the background haha. It was fun messing around and mixing the song.

“I found myself already satisfied…” – This song by Ae! group resonated deeply with me. It’s a reminder that even when life feels repetitive, there’s strength in holding onto the dreams we once chased. Their voices, their passion – it’s like they’re reaching out, pulling us forward step by step.

A song about perseverance, growth, and the journey of chasing dreams even when the path ahead seems unclear. These lyrics reflect the struggles and hopes they carry, reminding us that the best time to take a step forward is always right now.

First video of 2025! 
2024 was amazing on its own, but it had its ups and downs, but we persevered. We made it. 

Ae! group's debut and journey through 2024 has been one of the biggest inspirations and reasons for me to pick up singing and covering again. 

There's no way I'll ever be as good as them, but I'll try my best, in my own way. 

Filled with a few of my personal 2024 memories of Ae! group, and while this is far from perfect, I wouldn't have this any other way.

A version of the Bob Marley & The Wailers classic as part of a culture project according the "Reggae capitol" of Sweden - Skärblacka and how a small industrial town in the middle of nowhere became an important musical force in Swedish Reggae and how that has affected the local people and society. A collaboration with Kingston, Jamaica about young people, music and music production is also afoot.

Från Blacka Musiks hemsida http://blackamusik.com:
""Bortglömda Blacka och bruket" är namnet på ett projekt, som föreningen Blacka Musik fått stöd till från Kulturbryggan i Stockholm. Projektet ska fokusera på fenomenet Skärblacka, som ju blivit ett slags reggae-huvudstad i Sverige, och hur detta hänger ihop med bruksortens historia, samt hur det har påverkat människorna och samhället. Bland annat skall vi i projektet ta kontakt med Kingston på Jamaica, för att utveckla ett samarbete kring musik och ungdomar och nya former för musikproduktion."

description:
This song is so beautiful it almost makes my heart hurt a little. But isn't that like the best part about music? The way it makes you feel.




The lyrics translated:

"Bye bye nice times, you can go wherever you'd like. As long as you promise its because you want to. If it comes from you being scared, of letting me in, then it's not right.

That you leave this summer and now are leaving me. I honestly think I barely touched you. I'd like to fight to get you to understand, but if that's all you want then of course you can go. But it hurts a little bit.

But don't you care about my heart hurting, no leave it to me. I'd rather have pain than emptiness. I have yet to learn how to take it easy, I'd rather follow hope and believe that everything will be alright.

I know you're pretty and that can't be easy, to search for the answer and the one that's right. When all of my thought race and all memories watch, your life's biggest mistake could be that you let me go.

When you shrink, and the doubts arise. Then you'd like to be hold.
When you shrink, and the doubts arise. Then you'd like to be hold.

Sure it's a bit sad that even though you had a choice, can't see my goodness as something you'd like to keep. One day you'll sit down and see how life run past you, then you will regret that we didn't end up together.
And that hurt a little bit."

video_title: Loreen body Cover Dennis Queen
description:
Om du var tvungen att välja en artist som du relaterar till bäst, vem skulle det vara?
Jag inspireras av många olika artister. Jag inspireras oftast av Loreen och Lena Philipsson. De personerna står mig närmast musikaliskt. Genom de hittar jag mig själv och känner mig trygg. Jag känner även att jag inspireras av min omgivning ibland eller bara komma på historier som jag själv inte skulle vilja hända. Jag känner också att jag utvecklas själv som artist när jag skapar musik.
Kan du beskriva genren på din musik som du skapar?
Jag skulle absolut säga att ballad är min genre. Jag skapar en egen svär av min musik och försöker att inte dela in det i fack. Då känns det för pretatioöst, därför gör jag bara musik för att jag älskar det.
Är det någon/något som har influerat ditt musikaliska intresse?
Jag har alltid sjungit för mig själv och alltid känt en lust i mig. Jag försöker variera mig så gott jag kan som människa och artist. Jag influeras ju mest av min egen inspiration men försöker verkligen att vara optimistisk och öppen för nya vägar att se musikaliskt.
Är det viktigast att leva med musiken eller FÖR musiken? 
Jag lever för musiken. Jag vill utvecklas ännu mer än vad jag redan gör. Jag känner ett sug för att skapa ny musik och försöka att variera min stil. Samtidigt är det viktigt känner jag att leva MED musiken och det känner jag är viktigt att göra om en vill leva FÖR musiken.

description:
🎵 Just a Little Talk With Jesus — The Amateur Crooner

Sometimes the best prayers aren't long or complicated.

Sometimes we just need to have a little talk with Jesus. ❤️

“Just a Little Talk With Jesus” is a joyful old gospel song about bringing our troubles, worries, and burdens to the Lord and trusting Him to see us through.

Written by Cleavant Derricks in 1937, this song has become a beloved gospel standard and has been recorded by countless artists over the years.

I love the simple faith behind this song. We don't have to have the perfect words. We don't have to know exactly how everything is going to work out.

We can simply talk to Jesus.

And sometimes, that little talk can make all the difference. ❤️

description:
I’ve been walking out of burning rooms without a sound  
Keys on the table, dust still settling down  
They called it love, they called it war, they called my name  
But every door was just another version of the same  

I learned to read the air before a word was said  
Frequencies of silence ringing in my head  
I built a life on shifting ground and moving lines  
Kept everyone together, left myself behind  

I always been crazy, but it’s kept me from going insane  
I always been crazy, dancing in the rain  

They tried to reach me through a borrowed voice  
A friendly hand turned into noise  
I cut the wire, I closed the gate  
No more echoes to translate  

You can say I owe you, you can call me lost  
Count it in your ledgers, tally up the cost  
But I won’t trade my breath for borrowed peace  
I paid in full the day I chose release  

I always been crazy, but it’s kept me from going insane  
I always been crazy, breaking every chain  

I don’t hate you, I just stepped away  
From the fire that needed me to stay  
You can talk, you can rage, you can write my name in stone  
I’ll be somewhere quiet, finally my own  

There’s a silence now that doesn’t bite  
A different kind of lonely, but it feels right  
No more battles just to feel alive  
No more drowning just to prove I survived  

I always been crazy, but it’s kept me from going insane  
I always been crazy, standing in the rain  

So let it burn out, let it fade to black  
No more looking for the road back  
I didn’t lose you, I just found me  
In the space where I’m allowed to be  

I always been crazy, but it’s kept me from going insane  
I always been crazy… and I’m staying that way

Frieren at Journey's End is easily one of my favourite animes of the last few years, if not my favourite. Giving tons of The Lord of the Rings vibes while telling a pretty unconventional fantasy tale of lost love and mourning. I highly recommend it!

Startnummer 9 i finalen 2025 i Malmö

Artist: Måns Zelmerlöw
Bidrag: Revolution
Låtskrivare: David Lindgren Zacharias, Måns Zelmerlöw, Ola Svensson, Sebastian Atas

Med en karriär som sträcker sig över nästan två decennier är Måns Zelmerlöw utan tvekan en av Sveriges mest framstående och älskade artister, både nationellt och internationellt. Hans stora genombrott kom 2005, när han deltog i "Idol". Två år senare, 2007, stod han för första gången på Melodifestivalens scen med den ikoniska låten "Cara Mia", som tog honom hela vägen till finalen. Hans största musikaliska framgång i Melodifestivalen kom 2015, när han både tog hem tävlingen och Eurovision Song Contest med låten "Heroes”. 
Förutom musiken har Måns även lett flera populära tv-program, bland annat "Allsång på Skansen", och varit jurymedlem i den hyllade showen "Masked Singer". Tio år efter succén med "Heroes", återvänder denna mello-veteran för fjärde gången till Melodifestivalen.

Startnummer 6 i deltävling 4 2025 i Malmö

Artist: Måns Zelmerlöw
Bidrag: Revolution
Låtskrivare: David Lindgren Zacharias, Måns Zelmerlöw, Ola Svensson, Sebastian Atas

Med en karriär som sträcker sig över nästan två decennier är Måns Zelmerlöw utan tvekan en av Sveriges mest framstående och älskade artister, både nationellt och internationellt. Hans stora genombrott kom 2005, när han deltog i "Idol". Två år senare, 2007, stod han för första gången på Melodifestivalens scen med den ikoniska låten "Cara Mia", som tog honom hela vägen till finalen. Hans största musikaliska framgång i Melodifestivalen kom 2015, när han både tog hem tävlingen och Eurovision Song Contest med låten "Heroes”. 
Förutom musiken har Måns även lett flera populära tv-program, bland annat "Allsång på Skansen", och varit jurymedlem i den hyllade showen "Masked Singer". Tio år efter succén med "Heroes", återvänder denna mello-veteran för fjärde gången till Melodifestivalen.

video_title: FINALEN: Dotter - It's Not Easy to Write a Love Song
description:
Startnummer 8 i finalen 2024 i Stockholm
Artist: Dotter
Bidrag: It’s Not Easy to Write a Love Song
Låtskrivare: Johanna "Dotter" Jansson och Dino Medanhodzic.

Bakom Dotter finns den värmländska sångerskan och låtskrivaren Johanna Maria Jansson. Namnet anspelar på Moder Jord och Johannas förkärlek till djur, natur och världen vi lever i.

Sedan debuten 2014 har hennes musik haft en tematisk koppling till livsåskådning och personliga värderingar. Det stora genombrottet kom med ”Bulletproof”, som blev tvåa i Melodifestivalen 2020. Låten tog sedan en förstaplats på Svensktoppen och plats 49 på Spotifys världshitslista. 

Melodifestivalåret därpå kom hon fyra med ”Little Tot”.

Dotter har under åren spelats flitigt på svensk radio och samarbetat med namnkunniga hitmakare som Michael Angelo (Sam Smith, Lady Leshurr), David Sneddon (Lana Del Rey) och Will Hicks (Ed Sheeran och Beyonces ”Perfect”).

På meritlistan som låtskrivare har hon bland annat ”A Million Years” med Mariette och ”Victorious” med Lina Hedlund. Hennes samarbete med Måns Zelmerlöw i ”Walk With Me”, som de framförde i en mellanakt i Andra chansen 2019, ledde till att hon uppträdde på Zelmerlöws turné. Hon har också turnerat tillsammans med Miss Li.

to write a love song
When I can’t
leave the past behind

to write you a love song
When all the words

Throw your cigarette
Lay down in the bed

Put our minds to rest

bullets on the ground

speak about it all

video_title: FINALEN: Maria Sur - When I’m Gone
description:
Startnummer 1 i finalen 2024 i Stockholm
Artist: Maria Sur
Bidrag: When I’m Gone
Låtskrivare: Julie "Kill J" Aagaard, Maria Sur, Jimmy "Joker" Thörnfeldt och Anderz Wrethov

19-åriga Maria Sur är Melodifestivalens yngsta artist 2024. Hon är född och uppvuxen i Zaporizjzja i Ukraina. När Rysslands fullskaliga invasion inleddes i februari 2022 var hon en av deltagarna i landets pågående upplaga av The Voice.

Maria och hennes mamma flydde landet för tryggheten i Sverige, där hennes moster bor, medan hennes pappa tvingades stanna kvar. I Sverige började Maria snart fundera på hur hon skulle kunna fortsätta sin nyss påbörjade artistkarriär.

Hon sökte upp en mängd personer som sysslar med musik. Sarah Dawn Finer svarade och rekommenderade Maria till galan ”Hela Sverige skramlar”, som kom att samla in omkring 80 miljoner kronor till hjälparbete i Ukraina. ledde till att hon kunde ge ut singeln ”That’s The Way” samt medverka i bland annat Lotta på Liseberg, Natonaldagsgaloppen och Nyhetsmorgon.

I Melodifestivalen 2023 gick Maria direkt till final med ”Never Give Up” och fick flest röster i sin deltävling. Texten handlade om att följa sina drömmar och att aldrig ge upp, trots det som händer i världen

Deltagandet gav fart åt hennes artistkarriär i Sverige. Sedan dess har hon gästat Rix FM Festival och gjort en turnésommar med Diggiloo med 26 stopp mellan Ystad i söder och Höga kusten i norr.

Sedan hösten 2023 pluggar hon svenska på SFI samtidigt som hon läser musik på distans vid universitet i Kiev. Maria har också släppt två jullåtar: en cover av Ariana Grande och Kelly Clarksons ”Santa Can’t You Hear Me” och den nyskrivna ”No More Christmas Tears”.

video_title: Lillasyster - Till Our Days Are Over
description:
Startnummer 2 i deltävling 4 2022. Artist: Lillasyster. Bidrag: ”Till Our Days Are Over”. Låtskrivare: Palle Hammarlund, Jimmy Jansson, Ian-Paolo Lira och Martin Westerstrand.

Lillasyster debuterade 2007 med albumet ”Hjärndöd musik för en hjärndöd generation”. Sedan dess har bandet släppt fyra album, turnerat och nominerats till flera svenska Grammisar för Bästa Hårdrock.

I Sverige är Lillasyster främst känt för sina energifyllda liveshower. Deras cover på Rihannas hit ”Umbrella” gjorde att det nystartade bandet uppmärksammades bland rockpubliken internationellt. Bandet spelade år 2011 in ”Till Scandinavium”, entrélåt till hockeylaget Frölundas hemmamatcher.

I början av 2020 släppte Lillasyster ”Enemy”, bandets första originallåt på engelska. Med "Pretender" i Melodifestivalen 2021 fortsatte de på inslaget spår och tog sig till Andra chansen.

Lillasyster är det första band sedan State of Drama i Melodifestivalen 2014 som tävlar i Melodifestivalen utan att debutera.

description:
En cover på Birger Sjöbergs visa från 1922, som användes i Tage Danielssons komedi med samma namn, "Släpp fångarna loss - det är vår!"

Text:

"Släpp fångarne loss, det är vår!" 
Var mänska i sin själ 
i grunden vill så väl!"

Åh, aldrig jag tror, att det går 
av sociala skäl, 
av sociala skäl. 
Men gärna för mig! Om jag konstapel vore, 
jag öppnade. Nyckel kved på Fridas milda bud: 
De komme i trav, så vilda ut de fore 
och andades av luften ljum och såge vårens skrud!

"Släpp fångarne loss, det är vår! 
Var mänska i sin själ vill väl, 
när grön Naturen står!"

När natten är inne 
(är Frida nu med på mitt resonemang?) 
förskräckes vart sinne: 
en klämtning i kyrktornet klang! 
Och bort emot söder
se, rökpelarn stiger mot himmelens grund! 
Det pyr och det glöder, 
och brandkåren bullrar på stund!

"Släpp fångarne loss, det är vår! 
Var mänska i sin själ vill väl, 
när grön Naturen står!"

Och Rådman är vaken; 
vid fönstret han skakar för kylande vind. 
I skenet av staken 
står dottern så bleknad om kind. 
En dörr börjar dundra, 
ur mörkret framstörtar en svartskäggig man: 
"Tag hit ett par hundra! 
Nu brådskar det, gubbe, minsann!"

"Släpp fångarne loss, det är vår! 
Var mänska i sin själ vill väl, 
när grön Naturen står!"

Med fickorna fulla 
av pengar han rusar mot dörren och lyss. 
Han vänder: "Min pulla, 
ro hit med en smällande kyss!" 
Den gamle han ryter, 
så blodet hos boven blir kallt som en is, 
och luft honom tryter: 
"Tag hellre min silverservis!"

"Släpp fångarne loss, det är vår!" 
Var mänska i sin själ 
i grunden vill så väl!" 
Jag tvekar, som Frida förstår, 
av sociala skäl, 
av sociala skäl. 
Dock, gärna för mig! Om jag konstapel vore, 
jag öppnade. Nyckeln kved på hennes milda bud. 
Men stunden därpå jag brått från staden fore, 
och mina händer tvådde jag från följderna, vid Gud!

"Släpp fångarne loss, det är vår! 
Var mänska i sin själ vill väl, 
när grön Naturen står!"

video_title: Välkommen till New Orleans (Sång: Viktor Tunevi)
description:
En cover på "Down in New Orleans", som kommer från en av Disneys mest underskattade filmer, "Prinsessan och grodan". Musiken och originaltexten (som jag egentligen gillar bättre än den svenska, om jag ska vara ärlig) är skriven av giganten Randy Newman och den svenska texten är skriven av Ulricha Johnson.

Här är hennes text:

Ner i Södern
Finns ett ställe
Längst nere vid floden
Där finns världens vackraste mamseller
Och män som vet vad som gäller

Se'n musiken som alltid spelar
Börjar på dan tills natten är slut
Och när du hör musiken spela
Bleknar din sorg, bekymren ebbar ut

Ta nåns hand och va spontan
Ta med dig pensel
Vi färglägger stan
Ja, sockersöt blir hela dan
Välkommen till New Orleans

Här finns magi, svart och vit
Våga dig hit, gör oss en visit
Fånga lyckan eller gå på en nit
Nere i New Orleans

Ursäkta - om jag stör
Kom och testa, vi vet vad vi gör
Vill du vara med om livet, innan du dör
Gör det här i New Orleans

Här bor miljonärer
De har bomullsfält och sockerplantage
Fattiga, rika, dom drömmar som finns
Dom kan slå in i New Orleans

Saori Seto och Ayumi Fujimura är yngst och lika gamla och dem båda är 36 år (de fyller 37 år på Tisdag) Fujimura gör rösten till Fi från Skyward Sword och Hyrule Warriors spelen inklusive prinsessan Zelda i A Link Between Worlds medan Saori gör rösten till Sheik i Hyrule Warriors spelen (Saori gör även den japanska rösten till karaktären Anna från Fire Emblem serien)

From Hyrule Warriors and Smash Ultimate
